sources.note: Main vendor website. Heavily JavaScript-rendered; timed out and rendered blank in both web scraping and browser. Could not extract content directly.
EHR product page. Also failed to render; only returned fancybox JavaScript snippet.
Mandatory disclosures page. Failed to render; only returned JavaScript code fragments.
Patient portal page. Failed to render meaningful content.

myPersonalChart patient portal help manual. Detailed feature descriptions: messaging, problem lists, allergies, medications, lab results, immunizations, vitals, appointments, refill requests, referral requests, CCD export/import, demographics, insurance info, clinical documents.

Medigy vendor profile. Listed DigiDMS as offering EHR, Medical Billing, and Practice Management. Mentioned ONC-ACB certification, batch eligibility checks, auto-generation of claims, 201-500 hospitals/healthcare clients. Address: 2222 Morris Ave, Union, NJ.

Cardiovascular Buyers Guide listing. Confirmed 300+ medical offices, 32+ domestic and 175+ overseas employees. Listed offices in NJ, TX, NC. States available in 12+ states. Described as 'Virtual Secretary' for hospitals, clinics, independent doctors.
FindEMR listing. Described DigiDMS as cloud-based document management with EHR capabilities. Mentioned customizable workflows, OCR, mobile apps, HIPAA compliance. Zero user reviews found on platform.

DigiDMS webinar (2014) on patient engagement via patient portal. Referenced PHR data sharing, encounter notes, clinical summaries, patient charts, documents, patient education, screening modules, and secure messaging.
DigiDMS webinar (2014) on billing/PM features: claim scrubber technology, HCFA form generation, ICD-10 coding support. Confirms billing module is part of the integrated platform.
myPersonalChart Android app listing. Confirmed mobile patient portal app exists. Content could not be fully extracted.
MedicalRecords.com listing. Page content was mostly framework code; minimal useful information extracted.
ZoomInfo company page. Access blocked (403). Could not retrieve company details.
